name: Query Output / Tuple Count on a Given Instance
recognitionClueHinglish: Tables ka instance aur ek SQL query di hai; output values ya number of tuples poochhe hain (55 me se 21).
whatShouldComeToMind: NULL, duplicates, join multiplicity par nazar rakho.
generalSolvingApproach: 1. FROM/JOIN se rows ki table banao.
variationsObserved: NATURAL JOIN + subquery (derived table) ka count.
Range of tuples: maximum/minimum possible output size given constraints.
commonTraps: NULL rows ko count/avg me galat treat karna.
Join se duplicates bane, uska aggregate par asar bhoolna.

name: What Does the Query Compute / Which Query is Equivalent
recognitionClueHinglish: Query di hai aur poocha hai wo kya list karti hai (second highest, rank, students who...), ya kaunsi query same answer degi.
whatShouldComeToMind: Query ko English me translate karo.
Correlated subquery / NOT IN / ALL ke patterns pehchano.
generalSolvingApproach: 3. Chhoti sample table par test karo.
variationsObserved: Rank customers by balance (count of higher balances).
Division-style 'all courses / all parts' queries via NOT EXISTS / NOT IN.
commonTraps: Queries ko 'similar' dikhne par equivalent maan lena (duplicates/NULL me farak).

name: Write SQL / Relational Algebra Query
recognitionClueHinglish: Schema diya hai; SQL ya algebra me query likhni hai (descriptive, mostly pre-2003).
whatShouldComeToMind: Requirement ko FROM, WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING me todo.
variationsObserved: View define karna (bank transactions ka balance).
commonTraps: Join condition bhool jaana (accidental cross product).

name: SQL Concepts (NULL, clauses, constraints, foreign keys)
recognitionClueHinglish: True/false: duplicates, HAVING bina GROUP BY, NULL comparison, foreign key vs check, indexes ki zaroorat, disk-based query cost.
whatShouldComeToMind: Yeh facts direct yaad hone chahiye: SQL duplicates rakhta hai, HAVING bina GROUP BY chalti hai, NULL comparisons unknown.
generalSolvingApproach: 1. Har statement ko definition ya chhote example se test karo.
variationsObserved: Foreign key ko check assertion se replace karna possible hai ya nahi.
commonTraps: Aisa maan lena ki SQL result set hota hai (multiset hota hai).
